nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address controlling onlyOwner functions.
BuyNFT.ceoAddress: privileged address controlling onlyCeoAddress functions (withdraw, cancelBussiness, changeCeo).
BuyNFT.Percen = 1000, denominator used in calFee for fee percentage scaling.
mapping(address => Game) public Games: per-game price book, sale list and fee config.
address[] public arrGames: registry of game/NFT contracts with listings.
External caller identity; attacker controlled, used for auth checks, ownership checks and as ETH/NFT recipient.
Sets owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Sets ceoAddress = msg.sender and seeds default game config.
Returns arrGames list.
External view wrapper calling IERC721(_game).ownerOf(tokenId) on an arbitrary contract.
Returns contract ETH balance.
Returns stored Price struct for a token in a game.
External view wrapper calling IERC721(_game).getApproved(tokenId).
Internal: writes Price(msg.sender, _price, _fee), pushes tokenId into tokenIdSale and registers _game in arrGames.
Computes fee = _price * Games[_game].Fee / Percen using SafeMath.
Computes the ETH amount (_Need) required to outbid the current listing.
payable listing function guarded by isOwnerOf; computes need/fee and calls setPrice with attacker supplied _Price.
isOwnerOf guarded cancel: transfers stored fee to msg.sender then resets the price.
onlyOwner: sets Games[_game].Fee and limitFee with tautological require(_Fee >= 0 && _limitFee >= 0) on uint256.
onlyOwner batch version of setLimitFee over arrays.
onlyCeoAddress: withdraws arbitrary amount via internal _withdraw.
Internal: checks balance and sends ETH to msg.sender via transfer.
private: refunds stored fee to current owner/contract and resets the listing for one tokenId.
private: iterates Games[_game].tokenIdSale and cancels each listing.
onlyCeoAddress: cancels all listings for all registered games then sweeps the whole balance.
view: sums outstanding fees and returns balance minus fees.
onlyCeoAddress: transfers ceoAddress to a new non-zero address.
payable buy of a listed token: requires approval to this contract and exact msg.value, then transfers NFT and ETH to the seller.
internal: shifts and shrinks Games[_game].tokenIdSale by manual length decrement.
private: clears Price struct, removes tokenId from tokenIdSale and emits _resetPrice.
Native ETH transfer to untrusted msg.sender before listing state is reset (CEI violation).
Native ETH transfer to untrusted msg.sender from the contract balance.
Arbitrary external call IERC721(_game).transferFrom on a caller-supplied contract address.
Native ETH transfer of msg.value to the stored (potentially attacker-controlled) token owner before resetPrice.
Native ETH refund to tokenOwner before the listing is reset.
External view call to an arbitrary game contract inside loops and modifiers.
External view call IERC721(_game).getApproved used as the authorisation gate of buy().
Manual unchecked array length decrement (no SafeMath) in solidity 0.4.26.
caller supplied NFT/game contract address passed to sell.
caller supplied token id listed for sale.
caller supplied asking price used in fee computation.
Required ETH amount returned by calPrice in sell.
Computed fee stored into the Price struct by setPrice in sell.
ETH amount the ceo may withdraw.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership.
Boolean tracking whether _game is already present in arrGames.
IERC721 instance built from the caller supplied _game address in buy.
Token id the caller wants to buy.
Accumulated outstanding fee total in revenue.
Copy of Games[_game].tokenIdSale iterated by cancelBussinessByGame.
Balance minus accumulated fees returned by revenue.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner from the caller identity.
transferOwnership authorisation depends on msg.sender == owner via onlyOwner.
BuyNFT constructor sets ceoAddress = msg.sender, granting privileged role to the deployer.
setPrice stores Price(msg.sender, _price, _fee) as the tokenOwner.
sell uses msg.sender in the isOwnerOf modifier as the listing authorisation check.
removePrice pays out to msg.sender before resetting the listing state.
withdraw is gated by onlyCeoAddress comparing msg.sender to ceoAddress.
_withdraw sends ETH to msg.sender, allowing reentrant calls.
cancelBussiness is gated by onlyCeoAddress and ends with a full balance sweep.
changeCeo is gated by onlyCeoAddress and reassigns the privileged account.
buy forwards the NFT and ETH based on msg.sender supplied _game and receives the NFT.
ownerOf result is compared against the caller identity in the isOwnerOf modifier.
setPrice writes the tokenPrice and tokenIdSale entries of the Games mapping.
calFee reads Games[_game].Fee as the fee rate.
calPrice reads the stored Price and limitFee from Games.
sell reads and rewrites the Games price bookkeeping.
cancelBussinessByGameId reads Games[_game].tokenPrice and refunds the stored fee.
buy reads Games[_game].tokenPrice to validate price and route payment.
resetPrice clears the Price struct and removes the tokenId from tokenIdSale.
revenue sums Games[_game].tokenPrice fees across every listed token.
setLimitFee writes Fee and limitFee into the Games mapping.
setLimitFeeAll writes Fee and limitFee for multiple games.
getArrGames returns the arrGames registry.
setPrice scans and appends to arrGames when the game is unknown.
cancelBussiness iterates arrGames to cancel every game listing.
revenue iterates arrGames to accumulate outstanding fees.
ceoAddress is the privileged value checked by withdraw's onlyCeoAddress modifier.
changeCeo reads and overwrites ceoAddress after the onlyCeoAddress check.
Percen is the divisor scaling the fee in calFee.
sell calls calPrice to determine the required ETH amount.
sell calls calFee to compute the fee branches.
sell calls setPrice to persist the new listing.
sell can call resetPrice when the previous owner changed.
calPrice returns _Need which is stored in the local Need of sell.
the local fee computed in sell is passed into setPrice.
the flag computed in setPrice decides whether _game is appended to arrGames.
withdraw delegates the transfer to the internal _withdraw.
_withdraw performs a native ETH transfer to the caller, an external callback point.
cancelBussiness calls cancelBussinessByGame for each registered game.
cancelBussinessByGame calls cancelBussinessByGameId per token id.
cancelBussinessByGameId transfers stored ETH to the token owner before resetting state.
cancelBussinessByGameId queries the external NFT contract ownerOf during cancellation.
cancelBussinessByGameId calls resetPrice after refunding.
resetPrice calls _burnArrayTokenIdSale to shrink tokenIdSale.
_burnArrayTokenIdSale decrements the array length without SafeMath.
removePrice transfers ETH to msg.sender before clearing the listing, enabling reentrancy.
removePrice calls resetPrice after the payouts.
removePrice reads the external NFT owner to decide on repository transfer.
buy requires the external getApproved(tokenId) to equal address(this).
buy calls transferFrom on a caller supplied game contract, an arbitrary external call.
buy transfers msg.value to the stored token owner before resetPrice.
buy calls resetPrice after the NFT and ETH transfers.
revenue calls external ownerOf in nested loops over all games and tokens.
the _game parameter flows into sell and drives all external calls.
the _tokenId parameter selects the listing being sold.
the _Price parameter feeds the fee and setPrice computation.
the local fee is derived and used inside sell.
the local Need gates the msg.value requirement in sell.
the amount parameter controls the transferred value in _withdraw.
newOwner is assigned into the owner state variable.
the local flag is computed and used inside setPrice.
the local erc721Address is the interface used for all external calls in buy.
tokenId parameter identifies the NFT purchased in buy.
the local fee accumulates outstanding fees inside revenue.
the copied tokenIdSale array is iterated by cancelBussinessByGame.
the local amount is the returned revenue value.

normalization_plan.reason: The _game parameter only exists to address the sell call and its external NFT interactions, so it is absorbed into the sell function node.
_tokenId is a transient index into Games[_game].tokenPrice used solely by sell, so it merges into sell.
_Price is a scalar listing input consumed entirely by sell's fee and setPrice logic, so it merges into sell.
Need is a temporary result of calPrice used only to gate msg.value inside sell, so it merges into sell.
The local fee is the value written into the Price struct by setPrice, so it merges into the setPrice operation.
amount is only forwarded into the _withdraw helper and the resulting transfer, so it merges into _withdraw.
newOwner is a single-shot assignment target of the owner state variable inside transferOwnership, so it merges into that function.
flag is a temporary membership test for arrGames used only inside setPrice, so it merges into setPrice.
erc721Address is the local interface handle for the external calls made by buy, so it merges into buy.
tokenId selects the listing and NFT handled exclusively by buy, so it merges into buy.
fee is an accumulator used only to compute the returned amount in revenue, so it merges into revenue.
_arrTokenId is a copy of tokenIdSale iterated only by cancelBussinessByGame, so it merges into that function.
amount is the final returned balance-minus-fee value of revenue, so it merges into revenue.
